definition: a very big green fruit, red and juicy inside
description: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.
